basic_details.job_title: IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | junior research fellow: M. Sc. in Chemistry or allied branches from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale are eligible to apply for the JRF positions with valid GATE/ NET. For SC/ST/PwD category, a minimum 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA on 10-point scale is required with valid GATE/NET.

selection_process: Selection will be made through a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Prepare an application letter in plain paper.
Compile your recent bio-data, mark sheets, and certificates.
Send soft copies of the application letter, bio-data, mark sheets, and certificates by email to Dr. Papu Biswas, Associate Professor, Department of Chemistry at [email protected].
Make sure to send the email on or before 25 October 2026 up to 5:00 pm.
Mention a valid e-mail id and phone number for communication in all applications.
important_instructions: Short listing may be done before the interview if required. Physical documents will be verified at the time of joining. The selection will be canceled if any discrepancies are found in the documents at the time of physical verification. Duration of the project is five years from the date of commencement or till the project continues whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: IIEST Shibpur has invited applications for the post of Junior Research Fellow in the Department of Chemistry under a PAIR Network Project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to send soft copies of the application by email is 25 October 2026 up to 5:00 pm.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Chemistry or allied branches with minimum 60% marks (or 6.5 CGPA) along with valid GATE/NET. SC/ST/PwD candidates require 55% marks (or 6.0 CGPA) with valid GATE/NET.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years, with relaxations up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates.
